g.text: EcoPulse - Sequence Diagram (Waste Pickup Request, Route Optimization & Collection)
Phase 1: AI Waste Classification & Request Submission
List of pending pickups with coordinates & ward
Display pending pickups table & map markers
Select staff member & scheduled pickup date
Refresh assignment board & show success toast
Login & open Staff Scheduled Pickups for Date
Fetch ASSIGNED tasks for staff & selected date
Tasks list with pickup GPS coordinates & Ward MCF
Optimized driving order & road polyline geometry
Display interactive Leaflet route map & sequenced stops
Atomic update: status="IN_PROGRESS" for eligible pickups
notify_citizen("Staff En Route for Collection", citizenId)
Arrive at site, collect waste, take photo & enter weight (kg)
Show task resolved banner & update dashboard counts
